title: Build and use: kanban board app
message: Build a small kanban board web app in /workspace/kanban with three columns (To do, Doing, Done), add/move cards, and a tiny backend that saves cards to a JSON file. Run it in the background on port 8000. Then use the browser to: add three cards, move one to Done, reload the page and confirm the cards persisted. Take a screenshot after each step. Fix anything that doesn't work.
